mirrorsCurrent: data-current on the item, because the item is a different element from the trigger

advance.reason: Moving one step is a handler on the consumer's own button, not a button this family paints. Angular Material reaches the same conclusion with matStepperNext, which is a directive placed on a mat-button; a family that shipped its own would ship a second button nobody could theme with the first.

reflow.appliesTo: a stepper the consumer left horizontal
reflow.reason: Five labels in a row at 320 pixels are five columns two characters wide. Section 2.7 of docs/component-features.md asks responsiveness to change composition rather than size.

keyboard.effect: moves to each trigger the flow has not disabled
moves to the focused step when it is reachable
moves to the focused step when it is reachable
horizontal only: focuses the next trigger in the reading direction, wrapping and stepping over a disabled one
horizontal only: focuses the previous trigger in the reading direction, wrapping and stepping over a disabled one
vertical only: focuses the next trigger, wrapping and stepping over a disabled one
vertical only: focuses the previous trigger, wrapping and stepping over a disabled one
focuses the first trigger the flow has not disabled
focuses the last trigger the flow has not disabled

tabRole.reason: Angular Material gives a horizontal stepper role=tablist. Section 7 of docs/component-features.md forbids it in the Tabs entry itself: tabs are for peer views in one context, not for the steps of a process. The cost is written in the accessibility notes.

progressBar.reason: MUI ships a MobileStepper with a bar. The connector already paints how far the flow has come, the percentage is exposed to the consumer, and progress-indicator owns the bar itself.

validation.reason: Zag ships isStepValid and onStepInvalid, and Angular Material reads a stepControl. The change request in docs/state-and-events.md is already cancellable and already carries a reason, so a consumer refuses a move by cancelling it rather than through a second pair of hooks.

size.reason: Ant Design is the only surveyed implementation with a size step, and the three densities already restate the control scale.

panelAnimation.reason: Angular Material animates between panels. The panel is a disclosure and a fade delays reading; the connector and the marker transition instead, because those are the changes the eye has to follow.

literals.--slotted-stepper-reflow-breakpoint: The inline size below which a horizontal stepper becomes a column. A container query cannot read a custom property, which docs/token-foundation.md rule 4 states.
literals.--slotted-stepper-marker-ratio: The marker is a circle two thirds again the height of the type it holds, which is a proportion of a box rather than a step on a scale.
